SELECT c.Name
FROM country AS c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM countrylanguage AS cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'English'
      AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM countrylanguage AS cl
    WHERE cl.CountryCode = c.Code
      AND cl.Language = 'French'
      AND cl.IsOfficial = 'T'
)
ORDER BY c.Name;

metadata.full_spec_q: What are the names of nations where both English and French are official languages?
metadata.ground_truth_a: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"
